overview_description.description: Sponix is a developer of AI-powered sports technology designed to enhance live sports viewing experiences and optimize commercial opportunities for broadcasters, leagues, and rights holders. The company offers SPov, which provides immersive player point-of-view replays without the need for additional hardware, and SPboard, a virtual advertising solution that seamlessly integrates targeted, region-specific ads into live broadcasts in real time.

product.name: SPboard Virtual Advertisement
product.description: A software-based virtual advertising solution that overlays digital ads on sports broadcasts without hardware changes, supporting multi-regional targeting and various sports fields.

product.name: SPov Immersive Replay
product.description: A software-only immersive video replay system that creates player and referee point-of-view replays for live sports broadcasts, enhancing fan engagement and sponsorship integration.
